proposals.completion_signal: The entire tupperware lifts clear of the countertop and stays held.
proposals.observed_evidence: The tupperware rests beside the microwave; no grasp is established. The prior failed rollout remained at this counter with the container still on it.
proposals.subgoal: Grasp the tupperware container by its rim, avoiding the food inside, and lift it clear of the countertop.

proposals.completion_signal: The whole container rises clear of the counter and remains held.
proposals.observed_evidence: The gripper has moved down toward the tupperware since step 0, but the container remains on the counter. No grasp is established; the prior failure also stalled here.
proposals.subgoal: Align the open fingers around the near edge of the tupperware rim, lower to pinch the rim securely, then lift the entire container off the counter.

proposals.completion_signal: The entire container lifts clear of the counter and stays held.
proposals.observed_evidence: The gripper is closer to the container than at step 250, but the container still rests on the counter. A secure grasp is unconfirmed; the prior rollout stalled here.
proposals.subgoal: Grasp the exposed tupperware rim with one finger inside and one outside, close firmly, and lift the container clear of the counter.

proposals.completion_signal: The whole tupperware rises off the counter and stays held.
proposals.observed_evidence: Since step 350, the wrist view has shifted and the fingers have narrowed, but the container still appears on the counter. A secure grasp remains unconfirmed; the prior failure stalled here.
proposals.subgoal: Lift the tupperware straight up; if it stays on the counter, reopen the gripper and regrasp its exposed rim clear of the food.

proposals.completion_signal: The tupperware visibly clears the counter and remains held.
proposals.observed_evidence: The wrist view shifted since step 450, but the tupperware still appears supported by the counter. No secure lift is visible, resembling the prior stalled grasp.
proposals.subgoal: Open the gripper and reposition over an exposed side rim of the tupperware, clear of the food; grasp the rim and lift the whole container.

proposals.completion_signal: The entire tupperware lifts clear of the counter and stays held.
proposals.observed_evidence: The gripper is now open and the wrist view has shifted toward an exposed rim, but the container still appears on the counter. The prior rollout stalled at this grasp.
proposals.subgoal: Align the open fingers across the exposed right rim of the tupperware, lower to straddle the rim, close firmly, and lift the container.

proposals.completion_signal: The whole container visibly clears the counter and moves with the gripper.
proposals.observed_evidence: Since step 650, the gripper has closed and the wrist view has shifted, but counter clearance remains unclear. The failed rollout stalled beside this container.
proposals.subgoal: Keep the current grip and lift the tupperware vertically clear of the counter before moving toward the fridge.

proposals.completion_signal: The tupperware visibly clears the counter and follows the gripper.
proposals.observed_evidence: Since step 750, the container still appears on the counter with no clear lift. The closed gripper does not confirm a grasp; the prior rollout stalled here too.
proposals.subgoal: Open the gripper, reposition the fingers to straddle the tupperware's exposed rim, then close around the rim and lift clear of the counter.

proposals.completion_signal: The robot reaches the fridge with the tupperware still held clear of the counter.
proposals.observed_evidence: Compared with step 800, the tupperware appears raised beside the gripper and remains visible in the wrist view. This suggests progress beyond the prior rollout's counter stall; the fridge is outside the current views.
proposals.subgoal: Keep holding the tupperware level and move away from the counter toward the fridge, keeping the container clear of obstacles.

proposals.completion_signal: The counter is cleared and the fridge comes into view while the tupperware stays with the gripper.
proposals.observed_evidence: The tupperware remains beside the gripper across live views, suggesting it is held, but the robot is still near the microwave counter. The fridge is not visible; the prior failure also stalled at this counter.
proposals.subgoal: Keep the tupperware grasped and level. Back the mobile base away from the counter to clear it, then turn toward the fridge.

proposals.completion_signal: The tupperware rests fully supported on the top shelf and the gripper withdraws.
proposals.observed_evidence: The robot has moved from the microwave counter to the open fridge, unlike the prior stalled rollout. The tupperware remains visible beside the gripper and in the wrist view. Several small items occupy the top shelf.
proposals.subgoal: Lift the held tupperware level to the fridge's top shelf and place it in a clear space among the items. Release only when fully supported.

proposals.completion_signal: Tupperware is visibly lifted clear of the counter and held level.
proposals.observed_evidence: The food-filled tupperware rests on the counter; no grasp is established. The prior failed rollout spent many controls near this counter before reaching the fridge.
proposals.subgoal: Grasp the rim of the food-filled tupperware and lift it clear of the counter, keeping it level.

proposals.completion_signal: The tupperware rises with the gripper, visibly clear of the counter and level.
proposals.observed_evidence: The gripper has moved down to the tupperware rim since the previous view, but the container still appears on the counter; a secure grasp is unconfirmed. The failed rollout lingered here before reaching the fridge.
proposals.subgoal: Lift the food-filled tupperware straight up from the counter, keeping it level; confirm it moves with the gripper before carrying it.

proposals.completion_signal: Tupperware moves with the gripper and is visibly clear of the counter.
proposals.observed_evidence: Current and previous views show little change; the tupperware still appears on the counter and a secure grasp is unconfirmed. Prior failure also lingered here.
proposals.subgoal: Open the gripper, reposition it around the tupperware rim, close securely on the rim, then lift the container clear of the counter while keeping it level.

proposals.completion_signal: The tupperware is visibly lifted off the counter and travels with the gripper toward the fridge.
proposals.observed_evidence: The current and previous views show little progress: the tupperware remains near the counter, with no confirmed lift. Repeated grasp corrections have not visibly helped; the failed rollout also spent too long here.
proposals.subgoal: Pick up the tupperware containing the fish and lime, then carry it level to the fridge.

proposals.completion_signal: The container lifts clear of the counter and stays with the gripper.
proposals.observed_evidence: Since step 450, the container still appears supported by the counter and the base has barely moved. A secure grasp remains unconfirmed; the failed rollout also delayed transport.
proposals.subgoal: Grasp the outer rim of the fish-and-lime tupperware with the fingers straddling the rim, then lift it vertically clear of the counter.

proposals.completion_signal: The tupperware rises clear of the counter and moves with the gripper.
proposals.observed_evidence: The wrist view shifted slightly, but the tupperware still appears on the counter and the base is unchanged. A grasp is unconfirmed; prior failure also showed prolonged delay here.
proposals.subgoal: Lift the fish-and-lime tupperware clear of the counter; if it stays behind, open the gripper and regrasp its near rim.

proposals.completion_signal: The tupperware visibly clears the counter and follows the gripper.
proposals.observed_evidence: The container remains apparently supported by the counter, with little change since step 800 and no base movement. Repeated lifting prompts have not established a grasp.
proposals.subgoal: Open the gripper, reposition with one finger inside and one outside the tupperware rim, then close on the rim and lift the container.

proposals.completion_signal: The container visibly lifts off the counter and moves with the gripper.
proposals.observed_evidence: The wrist view is closer to the food, but the container still appears on the counter and the base is unchanged. The rim regrasp has not visibly succeeded.
proposals.subgoal: Raise the gripper clear of the tupperware, open it fully, then grasp the near rim of the container and lift it off the counter.

proposals.completion_signal: The tupperware visibly clears the counter and moves with the gripper.
proposals.observed_evidence: Current views and robot state are nearly unchanged from step 1000. The tupperware still appears supported by the counter; repeated regrasp prompts have produced no visible progress. Restore the original instruction and reassess before assuming transport is possible.

proposals.completion_signal: The open gripper is visibly above and clear of the container rim.
proposals.observed_evidence: Since step 1100, the arm has shifted slightly, but the tupperware still appears on the counter. No lift is confirmed; the prior failed rollout also never established shelf placement.
proposals.subgoal: Open the gripper and withdraw it upward clear of the tupperware rim to reset the grasp, leaving the food inside.

proposals.completion_signal: The tupperware visibly lifts clear of the counter with the food inside.
proposals.observed_evidence: Current views remain nearly unchanged from step 1200; withdrawal and a successful grasp are unconfirmed. The container still appears counter-supported. Prior failure never established shelf placement.
proposals.subgoal: Grasp the near rim of the tupperware and lift the whole container clear of the counter, keeping it level with the food inside.

proposals.completion_signal: The open fingers visibly straddle a side rim of the container.
proposals.observed_evidence: Since step 1300, the arm has moved slightly but the container still appears counter-supported; no successful lift is visible. The prior failed rollout never achieved shelf placement.
proposals.subgoal: Open the gripper, raise it clear of the food, and reposition over a side rim of the tupperware with one finger inside and one outside.

proposals.completion_signal: Tupperware is visibly held clear of the counter with its opening facing upward.
proposals.observed_evidence: Current cameras show the filled tupperware resting beside the stove; no grasp is established. The prior failed rollout carried it steeply tilted and did not finish closing the fridge.
proposals.subgoal: Grasp the filled tupperware beside the stove by its rim and lift it clear of the counter, keeping its opening facing upward.

proposals.completion_signal: Tupperware visibly rises clear of the counter, supported by the gripper with its opening upward.
proposals.observed_evidence: The hand has moved down to the tupperware and the wrist view is closer, but clearance from the counter and a secure grasp remain unconfirmed. Prior failure showed tilted transport.
proposals.subgoal: Secure the tupperware by its rim and lift it clear of the counter with its opening upward before moving toward the fridge.

proposals.completion_signal: Robot faces the open fridge with the tupperware held level near the top shelf.
proposals.observed_evidence: The arm has risen since the previous observation while the tupperware remains aligned with the wrist, suggesting a grasp; counter clearance is partly obscured. Prior transport showed substantial tilting.
proposals.subgoal: Carry the tupperware level with its opening upward to the open fridge, and align it with the top shelf without releasing it.

proposals.completion_signal: Open fridge shelves are centered in front of the robot, with the tupperware still supported by the gripper.
proposals.observed_evidence: Since step 350, the stove remains ahead and the open fridge remains at the left edge, indicating little navigation progress. Tupperware remains visible at the wrist; its levelness is uncertain. Prior transport showed pronounced tilting.
proposals.subgoal: Turn and move the base left toward the open fridge while keeping the tupperware supported and its opening upward.

proposals.completion_signal: Tupperware is held level at the top shelf opening, clear of the jar and other items.
proposals.observed_evidence: The open fridge now faces the robot, showing navigation progress since step 600. Tupperware remains visible at the wrist below the top shelf; its levelness is uncertain. The failed rollout lost sight of it without verified placement.
proposals.subgoal: Raise the supported tupperware to the top shelf opening, keeping its opening upward and aligning with clear space beside the jar. Keep holding it.

proposals.completion_signal: Tupperware is held above the top shelf edge, aligned with the clear space beside the jar.
proposals.observed_evidence: Since step 850, the tupperware has risen toward the shelves and remains visible at the wrist, but is still below the top shelf. Shelf support is not established; the failed rollout lost sight of the container without verified placement.
proposals.subgoal: Lift the tupperware above the top shelf's front edge, keeping its opening upward, and align it beside the jar. Keep holding it.

proposals.completion_signal: Tupperware bottom clears the top shelf's front edge, aligned with space beside the jar.
proposals.observed_evidence: The tupperware has risen since step 950 and remains visible at the wrist, but its bottom has not visibly cleared the top shelf. Support is unconfirmed; the failed rollout lost sight of it before verified placement.
proposals.subgoal: Raise the tupperware until its bottom clears the top shelf edge, then move it into the space beside the jar, opening upward. Keep holding it.

proposals.completion_signal: Tupperware rests fully on the top shelf beside the jar and stays there as the gripper withdraws.
proposals.observed_evidence: Compared with step 1050, the held tupperware has moved farther into the fridge near the top shelf beside the jar. Shelf support remains unconfirmed. The failed rollout lost sight of the container without verified placement.
proposals.subgoal: Set the tupperware flat on the top shelf beside the jar, opening upward and fully inside. Release only once supported, then withdraw the gripper.

proposals.completion_signal: Gripper clears the tupperware, which remains stationary and fully supported on the top shelf.
proposals.observed_evidence: Since step 1150, the gripper has opened and withdrawn somewhat; the tupperware remains visible beside the jar near the top shelf edge. Full support is still uncertain, unlike the failed rollout where it disappeared from view.
proposals.subgoal: Withdraw the open gripper clear of the tupperware without disturbing it. Leave it resting on the top shelf beside the jar before closing the door.

proposals.completion_signal: Fridge door is fully closed with the tupperware remaining inside on the top shelf.
proposals.observed_evidence: Since step 1250, the open gripper has withdrawn farther while the tupperware remains beside the jar, appearing supported on the top shelf. Unlike the failed rollout, the container is still visible after release. The fridge door remains open.
proposals.subgoal: Leave the tupperware beside the jar on the top shelf. Move the arm clear of the shelves and close the fridge door fully.

proposals.completion_signal: One broccoli is visibly held and lifted clear of the refrigerator shelf.
proposals.observed_evidence: Current cameras show an open refrigerator with broccoli on the shelf ahead; no grasp is established. The prior failed rollout left steak on the floor.
proposals.subgoal: Grasp the broccoli on the refrigerator shelf directly ahead and lift it clear of the shelf before moving away.

proposals.completion_signal: Broccoli is visibly held clear of the shelf as the arm retracts.
proposals.observed_evidence: The arm has reached into the refrigerator and broccoli is close to the gripper in the wrist view, but lift clearance is unconfirmed. The prior failure left steak on the floor.
proposals.subgoal: Secure the broccoli by its stalk, lift it clear of the shelf, and retract it out of the refrigerator while keeping it held.

proposals.completion_signal: The carried broccoli is released inside one tupperware and remains there.
proposals.observed_evidence: The arm has retracted from the shelf while broccoli remains at the gripper in the wrist view, supporting a successful grasp. The prior failed rollout left food on the floor.
proposals.subgoal: Carry the held broccoli clear of the refrigerator to a tupperware on the nearby counter; lower it inside before releasing.

proposals.completion_signal: Broccoli rests inside one tupperware after the gripper releases and withdraws.
proposals.observed_evidence: The robot has moved from the refrigerator to the island with broccoli still visible at the gripper. Tupperware is farther along the counter beside the sink; placement is unconfirmed. Prior failure dropped steak onto the floor.
proposals.subgoal: Keep the broccoli held while moving along the island to the tupperware beside the sink; position it over one container, lower inside, then release.

proposals.completion_signal: Broccoli remains inside the tupperware after the open gripper lifts away.
proposals.observed_evidence: The robot has reached the containers beside the sink. Wrist view shows broccoli within one container's rim, but release is unconfirmed. Prior failure left food on the floor.
proposals.subgoal: Finish placing the broccoli in the tupperware beneath the gripper: lower it gently inside, open the gripper, then lift clear, leaving broccoli in place.

proposals.completion_signal: A second broccoli is visibly held clear of its source; the placed broccoli remains in its container.
proposals.observed_evidence: The gripper has withdrawn and broccoli rests inside the left tupperware; the right container is empty. The prior failed rollout dropped steak during transport.
proposals.subgoal: Leave the placed broccoli undisturbed. Return to the open refrigerator and grasp another broccoli for the empty tupperware; lift securely before moving.

proposals.completion_signal: Second broccoli visibly held clear of the refrigerator shelf.
proposals.observed_evidence: Robot has returned to the open refrigerator. Broccoli is visible on an upper shelf; the gripper remains below it with no visible grasp. Previously placed broccoli was secure in its container. Prior failure dropped food during transport.
proposals.subgoal: Raise the gripper to the broccoli on the refrigerator shelf, grasp it, and lift clear before backing away. Preserve the broccoli already packed.

proposals.completion_signal: Broccoli is visibly held and lifted clear of the food shelf.
proposals.observed_evidence: The gripper has risen since the previous observation but remains below the food shelf and visibly empty. Broccoli remains between the brown item and steak. Prior failure showed dropped food during transport.
proposals.subgoal: Reach above the refrigerator's glass shelf to grasp the green broccoli between the brown item and steak. Lift it clear before backing away.

proposals.completion_signal: Broccoli visibly held above and clear of the refrigerator shelf.
proposals.observed_evidence: The arm has reached the food shelf since the previous review. The wrist view centers on the steak, with broccoli to its left; neither is visibly lifted. Prior failure showed food dropped during transport.
proposals.subgoal: Move the gripper left from the steak to the broccoli, grasp the broccoli, and lift it clear of the shelf before backing away.

proposals.completion_signal: Steak visibly clears the refrigerator and remains held while approaching the tupperware.
proposals.observed_evidence: The arm has retracted while the steak remains close in the wrist view and broccoli recedes on the shelf, suggesting a steak grasp rather than broccoli. Secure retention is uncertain; the prior failure showed dropped steak.
proposals.subgoal: Secure the steak between the fingers, lift it clear of the shelf, then carry it to a nearby tupperware while keeping the grasp closed.

proposals.completion_signal: Steak remains held at the counter, positioned above a tupperware opening.
proposals.observed_evidence: Compared with the previous view, the robot has backed away from the refrigerator with the steak still visible between the fingers and close in the wrist camera. The prior rollout dropped steak during transport; the destination is not yet visible.
proposals.subgoal: Carry the held steak to the nearby counter with the gripper closed, then position it above a tupperware that still needs a steak.

proposals.completion_signal: Steak rests inside the tupperware with broccoli after the gripper releases it.
proposals.observed_evidence: The robot has reached the counter from the refrigerator, with steak still visible between the fingers and in the wrist view. A tupperware containing broccoli is visible beside an empty one. The prior rollout dropped steak during transport.
proposals.subgoal: Keep the steak grasped while aligning over the tupperware containing broccoli, then lower it inside and release.

proposals.completion_signal: The tupperware holding the steak also contains one broccoli.
proposals.observed_evidence: Previously the steak was held during transport; now it appears inside the nearer tupperware. The broccoli remains in the separate tupperware by the sink. Release is not fully clear, but no floor drop is visible as in the failed rollout.
proposals.subgoal: Leave the steak in the nearer tupperware and withdraw the gripper. Fetch another broccoli and place it beside that steak; preserve the other broccoli.

proposals.completion_signal: Another broccoli is visibly held after lifting it from its source.
proposals.observed_evidence: The gripper has withdrawn from the steak, which remains in the nearer tupperware. The other tupperware still holds broccoli; no second broccoli has been added. The current wrist view shows no held food. The failed rollout dropped steak during transport.
proposals.subgoal: Leave both packed items in place. Navigate to the refrigerator and grasp another broccoli for the tupperware containing steak; hold it securely for transport.

proposals.completion_signal: The refrigerator interior is visible and another broccoli is visibly lifted in the gripper.
proposals.observed_evidence: The robot has moved from the lunch counter to the tall cabinet area. No food is visible in the wrist view, and the refrigerator interior is not visible. Previously placed steak and broccoli are now out of view. The failed rollout showed a steak dropped during transport.
proposals.subgoal: Face the refrigerator and open its door, then grasp and lift another broccoli securely for the tupperware containing steak. Preserve the placed food.

proposals.completion_signal: Refrigerator opens enough to reveal food, and broccoli is visibly lifted securely.
proposals.observed_evidence: The robot has reached the refrigerator from the tall cabinet area. A narrow interior section is visible, but no broccoli or held food is apparent. Previously placed food is out of view. The failed rollout dropped steak during transport.
proposals.subgoal: Open the refrigerator door wider to see the food, then securely grasp and lift another broccoli for the tupperware containing steak.

proposals.subgoal: Move the red fish clear of the refrigerator, carry it over one tupperware on the nearby counter, and lower and release it inside.

proposals.subgoal: Leave the packed fish undisturbed. Turn back toward the open refrigerator, reach the lower-shelf carrot, and grasp and lift it clear of the shelf.

proposals.subgoal: Withdraw the open gripper from the dark fish, then grasp the carrot around its orange body away from the fish and lift it alone.
